text: CM-061 writes C3 once, at the brief approval, but the location briefs give 'suggested headings (writer may re-word inside the rules)' and some FAQ questions say 'writer may re-word'. Drafts never write the Brand Guide, so any heading or FAQ the draft re-words leaves C3 out of step with the shipped page, and later sections check collisions against stale rows.
workaround: C3 records the H2s and FAQ questions exactly as briefed (locations, 107 rows). The draft checker pass should hold each draft to its briefed headings, or list any re-word as a Fix-and-list row so the next write-back (or a system fix) can correct C3.

workaround: Drafts state no unconfirmed figure, cite the brief-time reading, and tell the reader to ask the office; list each for the drafts review.

text: review.py apply ends with 'apply every item to its page in this run, then re-record the files', but no command says how. Re-recording each draft with status.py page-stage from the one review run would give every page the same run and agent, which per_page_files then refuses as one context for all pages (CM-043). The page-stage sha is stored but never checked, so the edited drafts stay recorded under their own-run records.
workaround: Applied the review items to the drafts in this run, logged each change with run.py change (old/new snapshots), and recorded the section with status.py batch locations --state drafts_written --review-sheet …; page-stage records were not re-written.
